description: Choose an HTTP 402 payment solution from requirements rather than from rank. Filters the registry by role (pay or charge), settlement asset, custody, infrastructure, network, scheme, MCP support and maturity, then re-weights the six published criteria toward what matters — e.g. sub-cent amounts weight settlement cost heavily. Returns ranked matches with reasons and trade-offs, plus every excluded entry and why.

chain.description: Required network, e.g. lightning, base, solana, tempo.

custody.description: self: the agent or service must hold its own keys.

infrastructure.description: none: no node or server infrastructure to operate.

needs_mcp.description: Require a native MCP server or MCP-native tooling.

production_only.description: Exclude alpha, preview, inactive and unstated maturity.

role.description: pay: an agent paying for resources. charge: a service charging agents.

typical_amount_usd.description: Typical payment size in US dollars, e.g. 0.001 for a sub-cent API call.

name: recommend_payment_rail
title: Recommend a payment rail for your requirements
